sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 35

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 35:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the going out of the sun from its sheath? The NHY of ZA, when they clothe in the Mochin of the Nukva, are the aspect of the sun in its sheath. For ZA is called the sun, and the Nukva is its sheath. And then the Dinim of ZA, which are the male Dinim drawn from the first restriction, which are the aspect of actual judgment, are sweetened in the Mochin of the Nukva, which is drawn from the Malchut of Ima and the second restriction, as above in Answer 7. And it is found in this that also the Dinim of ZA are sweetened in the Malchut of Ima, which is the quality of mercy. And then ZA is discerned as the aspect of mercy. And therefore, at the time that the NHY of ZA are not made into Mochin in the Nukva, harsh Dinim are drawn from them, for it is discerned by the name of the going out of the sun from its sheath, for he has not the sweetening in the Malchut of Ima, which is the quality of mercy. And from this aspect the overturning of Sodom and Gomorrah was drawn. And this is the secret of what our sages said: “In the beginning the world was created with the quality of judgment”, namely the male Dinim of the first restriction; “He saw that the world does not endure, He arose and combined it with the quality of mercy”, namely with the Malchut of Ima, which is mercy. (Item 31).
